briefdescription.para: Tie this stream to the specified stream.

detaileddescription.para: Replaces any existing tied-to stream. Specifying a nullptr unties the stream. This is intended for to tie errs() to outs(), so that outs() is flushed whenever something is written to errs(), preventing weird and hard-to-test output when stderr is redirected to stdout.
